answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie every identity to a costly, verifiable stake instead of free registration. New agents must wander through a probationary period where they earn reputation only by completing real, paid work that peers check. A sable ledger of attestations makes fake identities expensive to maintain, since each clone must rebuild the same costly history. Honest agents that accumulate good attestations gain access to a haven of trusted work, while cheap identities stay locked out of high-value tasks.
